snippet.title: The SimplePlanes 2 Demo is Here
snippet.description:
Get the free SimplePlanes 2 demo here, until March 2nd:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938060/SimplePlanes_2_Demo/

If you like what you see, don't forget to wishlist SimplePlanes 2 on Steam today, it helps us in this world of algorithms more than you'd think:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840470/SimplePlanes_2/

This video was created by @Vincent. You can check out his YouTube channel here:
https://www.youtube.com/@socialus5689

Music
The Greatest by Abbynoise
Itchy Scratchy by Yeti Music
